facts.fact: Ministers of ICT of Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan signed a resolution in Nairobi on 29 April 2026 to jointly finance a feasibility study for a regionally owned communication and broadcasting satellite and to open a dedicated project account.
facts.system: Northern Corridor regional communications and broadcasting satellite
